data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 黄昏天台的微风侧颜
data.description: 千年主楼高层天台花园，落日余晖将远方摩天大楼群染成一片壮丽的金红。诺亚迎风伫立在观景栏杆前，白大衣下摆在风中猎猎作响，极长的银白发丝曼妙飞舞。她回首望向老师，落日余晖勾勒出无可挑剔的侧颜轮廓，眼神从容而摄人心魄。
data.action: standing near railing, turning back with windblown hair, sunset backdrop
data.lighting: brilliant golden hour rim light and warm dusk twilight
data.promptProse: Standing on a high skyscraper rooftop garden overlooking a vast modern metropolis at sunset, Ushio Noa turns back with wind-swept silver hair, bathed in radiant golden twilight.
data.animaCaption: Noa looking back with windswept hair on a sunset rooftop.
